features.title: Queue train, score, batch and inference containers on Redis + BullMQ, admitted by CPU/RAM
features.description: Every container mode goes through TrainningContainerAuthorizedService.spawn, and train, score and batch started immediately with no system-wide limit. Launch now records the row and adds a BullMQ job; one admission worker starts the container only when the host's CPU/RAM budget has room. The DB row stays the source of truth. User decision 2026-11-09: Redis + BullMQ over a Postgres dispatcher.

tasks.title: Measure peak memory and CPU per mode
tasks.detail: Sized on the largest real dataset (35,593 rows x 129 tags). Reservations default from these numbers. Measured 2026-11-09: GPR 2.40 GiB, LSTM 1.74, forest grid 0.70, Extra Trees 0.57, LightGBM 0.43, RF 0.39, XGBoost 0.25, load+predict 0.33.

tasks.title: Redis in docker-compose
tasks.detail: Own network, 127.0.0.1 only, requirepass, AOF, noeviction. Training containers run untrusted code on monorepo_network and must not reach it. Compose service written and validated. Blocked on the user setting REDIS_PASSWORD and REDIS_URL in .env and starting it.

tasks.title: Pure budget lib
tasks.detail: apps/backend/src/lib/container-budget.ts: reservations per mode, admit() returning fit / no-room / workspace-cap / too-big.

tasks.title: Dispatcher and spawn changes
tasks.detail: container-dispatch.service.ts; per-mode resources, workspace label, conditional status update, adopt by name.

tasks.title: Move call sites from spawn to enqueue
tasks.detail: Train, score (auto and manual), batch; cancel removes the job.

tasks.title: Split inference preparation
tasks.detail: inference-prep queue runs materialize so a slow PI fetch never blocks admission; run-now enqueues at priority 1.

tasks.title: scoringQueuedAt migration and score flow
tasks.detail: Hand-written SQL, applied by hand, never migrate dev.

tasks.title: Repair sweep and runtime limits
tasks.detail: Re-adds waiting rows with no job, fails over-long waits, kills containers past max runtime.

tasks.title: Client waiting state
tasks.detail: Waiting for compute with runs ahead; isScoring covers queued scoring.

tasks.title: Docs and live verification
tasks.detail: Budget set to one train slot: 3 trainings drain in order, live window passes training, cancel while queued, backend restart, Redis outage, Redis unreachable from a training container. Verified with the real dispatcher, Docker and Redis (fake DB, sleeping containers): one slot FIFO, inference passing training, freed slot admits next, cancel while queued, adoption, per-mode memory cap, Redis isolation. Not yet run: a real training through the UI, backend restart mid-train, Redis outage on the full stack.

acceptance_criteria: No container starts unless the CPU/RAM budget has room
Priority order is live inference, score, batch, train, backfill
A queued job survives a backend restart and a Redis outage
A job is never run twice for one row
A training container cannot reach Redis
known_gaps: Full-stack live run not done; needs Redis configured in .env.
Batch and score reservations are extrapolated from the load+predict and fit measurements, not measured on a real batch file.
On this 7.8 GiB Docker VM only one training runs at a time.
